text:
Frankfurt’s median asking rent sits at 17.5 €/m² in June 2026, placing the city second among the 37 most expensive markets. Year‑on‑year rents are up 3.2 % and have risen 24.4 % over the past five years, while the asking premium over existing rents reaches 65 %.  

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.9 % and listings staying on the market for just 25 days; 31 % are let within a week. A 60 m² apartment costs about 1 050 € per month, generating a rent‑burden of 21.4 % for two residents.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 18.52 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 18.0 €/m² and 18.96 €/m², implying a 5.8 % increase.
